# Deployment reference

Technical description of the deployed system. For *how to deploy it*, see
[deploy/README.md](../../deploy/README.md). For *why it is shaped this way*,
see [the explanation](../explanation/deployment-architecture.md).

Generated from the machinery, not transcribed from it — every value below is
read out of the file that actually configures it.

## Target host

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Tier | `s-1vcpu-512mb-10gb` |
| vCPU / RAM / disk | 1 / 512 MB / 10 GB |
| Included transfer | 500 GB per month |
| Profiling model | `systemd-run --scope -p CPUQuota=100% -p MemoryMax=390M -p MemorySwapMax=0` |

390M = 512 MB less roughly 120 MB of OS. DO droplets ship swapless.

## Environment variables

| Variable | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `UI_SERVO_INGEST_ROOT` | ingest | **required** — the directory *containing* `evidence/`; refuses a path ending in `evidence` |
| `UI_SERVO_INGEST_TURN` | ingest | turn id = JSONL filename; defaults to `prod-YYYY-MM-DD`, fixed at startup |
| `UI_SERVO_INGEST_FSYNC` | ingest | `1`/`0`; off by default |
| `SITE_ADDRESS` | caddy | site address; `mosoti.dev` in production, `localhost:8443` to test the same file |
| `SITE_ROOT` | caddy | document root, default `/opt/ui-servo/current` (a symlink swapped per deploy) |
| `INGEST_ORIGIN` | caddy | upstream for `/beacon*`, default `127.0.0.1:8111` |
| `BEACON_MAX_BODY` | caddy | request body cap on the write path, default `8KB` |
| `RL_BROWSE` / `RL_BEACON` | caddy | rate-limit budgets; each is a ring buffer, so large values cost memory |
| `HTTP_PORT` | caddy | plaintext port, default 80; overridable to test unprivileged |
| `UI_SERVO_EVIDENCE_DAYS` | prune | age cutoff in days, default `7` |
| `UI_SERVO_EVIDENCE_MAX_MB` | prune | size ceiling in MB, applied after age, default `256` |

## Edge: rate limits and body caps

| Zone | Events | Window | Applies to |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `beacon` | 6 | 1m | `POST /beacon*` |
| `browse` | 240 | 1m | everything else |

Request body on the write path is capped at **8KB**. Keyed on
`{remote_host}`. Exceeding a zone returns `429` with `Retry-After`.

## Edge: response headers

| Header | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `Strict-Transport-Security` | `max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload` |
| `X-Content-Type-Options` | `nosniff` |
| `X-Frame-Options` | `DENY` |
| `Referrer-Policy` | `strict-origin-when-cross-origin` |
| `Permissions-Policy` | `geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=(), payment=(), usb=()` |
| `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy` | `same-origin` |
| `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy` | `same-origin` |
| `Content-Security-Policy` | `default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inli…` |

`Server` is removed. Cache-Control is applied by path:

| Paths | Cache-Control |
| --- | --- |
| `/assets/fonts/*` | `public, max-age=604800` |
| `/assets/*` | `public, max-age=300` |
| `/sw.js` | `no-store` |
| `/ *.html /about/* /projects/* /writing/*` | `no-cache` |

Compression: `encode zstd gzip` for anything without a precompressed
sibling; `file_server` serves `precompressed br zstd gzip`. Brotli is
absent from the encoder list because this Caddy build registers
`http.precompressed.br` but not `http.encoders.br`.

## Edge: refusals

| Rule | Response |
| --- | --- |
| Method not in `GET HEAD POST` | `405` |
| Path matches a scanner probe (14 patterns) | `404` |
| `User-Agent` matches a declared crawler (17 names) | `403` |

Probe paths: `/wp-admin*` `/wp-login.php` `/xmlrpc.php` `/.env*` `/.git/*` `/.aws/*` `/vendor/*` `/phpmyadmin*` `/phpinfo.php` `/server-status` `/actuator/*` `/.ssh/*` `/config.json` `/telescope*`

Declared crawlers: `GPTBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `OAI-SearchBot`, `CCBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `anthropic-ai`, `Claude-Web`, `Bytespider`, `Amazonbot`, `FacebookBot`, `meta-externalagent`, `Diffbot`, `ImagesiftBot`, `Omgilibot`, `PerplexityBot`, `Applebot-Extended`, `cohere-ai`

Search-engine crawlers are deliberately absent from that list.

Server timeouts: `read_body=10s`, `read_header=5s`, `write=30s`, `idle=2m`, `roll_size=10MB`, `roll_keep=5`, `roll_keep_for=336h`, `request_body={`, `file_server={`.

## Ingest service

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Reached on | `127.0.0.1:8111` — a systemd socket, not a listening process |
| Activation | on demand; proxy exits after **5min** idle, backend follows via `StopWhenUnneeded` |
| Proxy ceiling | `32M` memory, `16` tasks |
| Memory at rest | **0** — the unit is inactive between beacons |
| Cold start / warm | 1.3 s / 19 ms |
| Routes | `POST "/beacon"`, `GET|HEAD "/beacon/health"` |
| Health | `200` normally, **`503` when evidence has been lost** |
| Entrypoint | `granian --interface asgi --factory ui_servo.adapters.beacon_ingest.app:create_app` |
| `MemoryHigh` / `MemoryMax` | `96M` / `128M` |
| `CPUWeight` / `CPUQuota` | `20` / `40%` |
| `TasksMax` | `24` |
| Writable paths | `/var/lib/ui-servo` |
| Restart | `on-failure` after `2s` |

Application-level limits, from `router.py`:

| Constant | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `MAX_BODY_BYTES` | `1 << 20` |
| `MAX_EVENTS` | `2000` |
| `MAX_PAYLOAD_DEPTH` | `6` |
| `MAX_PAYLOAD_KEYS` | `64` |
| `MAX_FIELD_CHARS` | `4096` |

Startup refuses, rather than guessing, on: a missing/blank/relative/nonexistent
root, a root ending in `evidence`, a turn id that is not a safe path component,
or a non-boolean fsync flag.

## Evidence retention

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Age cutoff | 7 days |
| Size ceiling | 256 MB |
| Schedule | `hourly`, `Persistent=true`, jitter `5m` |
| Order | age first, then size; never removes the last remaining file |

Storage cost, measured:

| Body cap | Body bytes | Events | Stored | Stored bytes | Amplification |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `32KB` | 32 761 | 2520 | 2000 | 268 890 | 8.2× |
| `8KB` | 8 191 | 630 | 630 | 83 680 | 10.2× |
| `4KB` | 4 096 | 315 | 315 | 41 895 | 10.2× |

At **132.8 bytes per stored signal**, with
truncation at `MAX_EVENTS = 2000`.

| Property | Value |

| OOM kills at that ceiling | 0 |

| Ingest peak | 82 MB |
| Cold visit | 20 requests, 137,943 bytes |
| `portfolio.js` precompressed | 14,514 B (vs 17,258 on the fly) |
| Service worker cache entries | 15 static / 0 origin |

Build, cold target directory, `-j1`, no swap:

| Ceiling | Result | Peak | Wall | Reclaim events |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 900 MB | exit 0 | 467.7 MiB | 243 s | 0 |
| 390 MB | exit 0 | 390.0 MiB | 271 s | 782 |

memory.peak counts reclaimable page cache, so it is an upper bound on appetite, not a requirement.

## Deploy key permissions

The CI key is pinned to a forced command. It may run:

| Request | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `rsync --server` into `/opt/ui-servo/incoming` or `/opt/ui-servo/app` | upload |
| `ui-servo-activate <hex>` | promote upload, swap symlink, prune to 5 |
| `ui-servo-sync-ingest` | `uv sync` + restart the ingest |
| `ui-servo-releases` | list releases |

Anything else is refused and logged. `rsync` invocations carrying `-e`/`--rsh`
are refused regardless of destination.
